verdict.rationale: The evidence describes online tax services such as account login, payments, simulations, forms, a tax calendar and automatic CFE direct debit, but none of them let users define event-triggered rules or automations. Automatic direct debit is a single preset payment option, not user-configurable event rules, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events
